recommendations.action: Decide T-R001-INT-001: build the planned integration test OR formally waive the integration tier
recommendations.details: Option A (build): Create tests/Hexalith.Tenants.Server.Tests/Projections/ProjectionWriteConformanceIntegrationTests.cs with TenantIndex_RealDaprBackedConflictThenSuccess_PreservesIndexAsync, using [DaprFact] or equivalent DAPR-precondition gating. Option B (waive): Author a sprint-change-proposal documenting why unit-level R-001 coverage (T-R001-UNIT-001/002) is sufficient and the integration tier is not required for epic close.
recommendations.owner: Story 10.4 follow-up dev or sprint-change-proposal author

recommendations.details: Mirror the TenantIndex_RetryExhaustion sentinel pattern (lines 167-232) but target the audit-key exhaustion path. Use sentinel values for audit narrative payload + user identifiers; assert they do not appear in Logger.Entries[i].Message or .StateText.
recommendations.given_when_then: GIVEN three queued projection events targeting an audit key whose ETag is contended by a parallel writer (scripted state store enqueues three conflicts in a row) AND the audit narrative + user identifiers carry sentinel values 'SensitiveAuditNarrative_DoNotLog' and 'SensitiveUserId_DoNotLog'; WHEN ProjectAsync is invoked and the retry budget exhausts on the audit-key save path; THEN ProjectAsync throws InvalidOperationException, logger captures exactly two EventId 100101 Warning entries followed by one EventId 100102 Error entry, AND no Logger.Entries[i].Message or .StateText contains 'SensitiveAuditNarrative_DoNotLog' or 'SensitiveUserId_DoNotLog'.

recommendations.details: Trigger mid-flow cancellation against a tenant audit query, assert OperationCanceledException is thrown and that any captured log entries do NOT contain sentinel tenant name / user identifier / cursor payload.
recommendations.given_when_then: GIVEN a GetTenantAudit query for a tenant whose audit narrative contains sentinel values 'SensitiveTenantName_DoNotLog' and 'SensitiveCursorPayload_DoNotLog', AND a CancellationToken that is signalled after authorization passes but before the audit state read returns; WHEN the actor query method is awaited; THEN OperationCanceledException is thrown (not converted to forbidden / not-found / invalid-cursor), AND any captured log entries during the cancellation path do NOT contain 'SensitiveTenantName_DoNotLog' or 'SensitiveCursorPayload_DoNotLog' in Message or StateText.
